notes: The colophon names no one. It has only the usual scribal verse (yādṛśaṃ pustakaṃ dṛṣṭvā ...) and a date. 'naṣṭa' before the month is unclear: it might be a corrupt word, or it might mean an omitted (kṣaya) month or tithi. The date matches the catalogue field (NS 934 bhādra kṛṣṇa 4). NS 934 is about 1814 CE.
